main_body: Large leafy tree canopy with a dark brown trunk and root flare at the bottom, drawn as an organic mass of greens
top_band: none: organic canopy with mottled light and dark greens, no distinct horizontal top surface plus front face structure
evidence: The object is an organic tree. The column scan shows alternating light green (L129) and mid green (L68) clumps with no structured top band, front edge line or step, which is expected for foliage. It is not a hard-surface piece, has no receding side face, and the canopy reads as a rounded volume with the trunk and roots below. The organic kind is plausible, so the 3/4 contract is not violated by a flat elevation, a slab or a rim.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 4 distinct colours (dark green, light green, dark brown trunk, near-black outline) against 427 and 567 in the references. Median colours per tile are 4 against about 108, which is far lower. Dark edge pixels are 100% neutral, so the outline is a near-black sticker line around the whole silhouette, while the references use tinted outlines (0% neutral). The canopy is a two-tone dither with only 2 greens, giving 3 shading steps against 5-6 in the references. Flat-fill coverage is low at 4% because of the dither pattern, but there is no per-leaf highlight, no mid-tone ramp and no clump structure. It is clearly shallower and flatter than the references.
